## Job Summary

An open, non-role-specific application into Fluidstack's Automation department. Fluidstack builds AI compute infrastructure — acquiring power, designing and building data centers, and operating them — and states its mission as delivering "10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else." Recruiting routes strong general applications to the team closest to fit. Full-time, on-site across San Francisco, CA / Austin, TX / New York, NY.
